name: xiaohongshu-post
description: Publish image-and-text notes to Xiaohongshu (RED) from a logged-in Chrome profile via Playwright over CDP. Covers a browser bootstrap that keeps the login alive across agent turn boundaries by persisting the Chrome profile (the browser process itself gets reaped), real topic-tag insertion through the Tiptap suggestion dropdown, pre-publish draft approval, and logged-out public-visibility verification.
